d:
Shri hanumanashtak aadity garhvi ke bhavyukt svar men. sankatmochan hanumanashtak ki sanrachna gosvami tulsidas ne ki thi. mana jata hai ki sankatmochan hanumanashtak ka path karne se vyakti apni har badha aur pira se mukt ho jata hai aur uske sabhi sankat dur ho jate hain.
Watch the video song of "Ashvmedh Ka Ashv Ram Ne Pujan Kar Choda" now!
Shri ram apne rajy ki vistar ke lie ashvamedh ka yagy karte hain aur uske lie vo ashvamedh ka ashv pujan karke charon deshao men use ghumne ke lie chhora jata hain.
"svar- ravindr jain, sushil aur sathi
Git- ravindr jain
Sangit- ravindr jain"
